# Gramlot 0.3.34

## Loading

- Collections no longer bundle their own copies of `@genrojs/*`, xmldom,
  decimal.js, msgpack and tytx: they read them from the core through
  `sharedModules`. A page with every standard collection goes from 5.3 MB to
  2.6 MB, and `instanceof` works across collections.
- Third-party libraries load on first use, in the pages that need them:
  ECharts, echarts-gl, uPlot, Plotly, Vega, write-excel-file, Jodit,
  CodeMirror, ProseMirror and typst. The manifest `libraries` gives each one an
  exact version, a jsDelivr URL, an integrity hash and a local copy;
  `loadLibrary` picks the source.
- A page with every standard collection now downloads 1.45 MB at start
  (406 KB gzip); a page with only inputs downloads no third-party library.
- Gramlot collections are always loaded.

## Servers

- New server option `library_source` (Python) / `librarySource` (JS): `cdn`
  (default) loads libraries from jsDelivr with integrity checks, `local` from
  the copies shipped with the collections. Serverless and file exports always
  use the local copies and work without network access.
- `content_security_policy(policy, nonce)` / `contentSecurityPolicy` composes
  the page policy: it fills the nonce and adds the CDN origin when libraries
  come from jsDelivr.
